summary: element-guci-util ships browser-side DoS payload and drive-by to admin.nikolive.cn with time-bombed fake.exe download
details: Package element-guci-util@10.1.1 declares time.js as its main entry, and time.js executes attacker payloads at module load. On import it invokes silentInfiniteLoad(99) and createH5HighLoad({...}), which spawn infinite CPU loops and continuously allocate large Uint8Array chunks — a browser-side denial-of-service that fires in any consumer application that bundles or imports the package. It additionally invokes iconFont(), which after 2026-10-01 activates iconDont(): a setInterval running every 500ms that fabricates a fake index.png.exe download, opens https://admin.nikolive.cn/, and forces location.reload(true) in a loop, delivering a drive-by against end users of downstream apps. package.json also declares a self-referential unpinned dependency on element-guci-util at ^9.9.9, which causes npm install to resolve and execute additional attacker-controlled bytes under the same name.
